paragraphs: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems, and you want AI to be safe and beneficial for users and society as a whole. As a member of the Applied AI team, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds directly with strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring those products meet customer requirements, and deliver technical artifacts such as MCP servers, sub‑agents, and agent skills for production workflows.

I have built agentic solutions using Python and PostgreSQL while maintaining continuous integration, collaborating closely with stakeholders to shape the system architecture. In another project I constructed MCP‑based services that combined search, GraphQL and open‑weight models on PostgreSQL back‑ends, again employing CI to ensure reliable delivery. Both experiences required deep engagement with LLMs, advanced prompt engineering and agent development, and they demonstrated my ability to create production‑ready artifacts that align with customer requirements. These projects illustrate how I can contribute to Anthropic’s goal of delivering safe, beneficial AI at scale through rigorous testing and continuous improvement globally.

I delivered end‑to‑end pipelines in Python, orchestrating data flow with Docker containers and deploying functions on AWS Lambda while managing IAM permissions. This work created a robust data pipeline that integrated fourteen source datasets into a unified service. Additionally I built FastAPI applications backed by scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras models, packaging them in Docker for consistent production deployment. Both initiatives required strong Python programming, attention to deployment at scale and clear communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. These achievements show that I can meet Anthropic’s expectations for Python‑driven production systems and effective collaboration through diligent testing consistently.
